prompt: I think we should create a formal process for how Helm handles security embargoes and coordinated disclosure with downstream distributors. Right now the SECURITY.md covers reporting but there's no documented process for how we coordinate with distro maintainers who package Helm before a CVE goes public.

assertions.name: valid_yaml_preamble
assertions.description: HIP starts with valid YAML frontmatter containing all required fields

assertions.name: all_required_sections
assertions.description: Contains all required sections per HIP-0001

assertions.name: references_existing_security_md
assertions.description: References or builds upon the existing SECURITY.md process rather than ignoring it

assertions.name: specification_defines_process
assertions.description: Specification section defines concrete process steps (timelines, roles, communication channels), not just abstract principles

assertions.name: no_code_specification
assertions.description: Does not include code-level implementation details (this is a process HIP, not a feature HIP)
